title: weinmannia parviflora var. glabrata
intro: Weinmannia parviflora var. glabrata, commonly known as a variant of the tītoki tree, is a plant species native to New Zealand. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, providing various health benefits including its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects, which can aid in wound healing and the treatment of infections. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its ability to exhibit antioxidant and antifungal properties, contributing to its potential in preventing cell damage and promoting overall well-being. Bioactive constituents present in Weinmannia parviflora var. glabrata include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
